cardinal_symptoms.en: poor appetite and reduced food intake
fatigue of the limbs, shortness of breath and reluctance to speak

tongue.en: Pale tongue with a white coating

etiology_zh: 饮食不节，劳倦过度，忧思伤脾，久病失养
pathomechanism_zh: 脾气不足，运化失健

treatment_principle.en: Augment qi and fortify the Spleen

description_zh: 脾气虚证为脏腑辨证中最常见的虚证之一，以食少纳呆、腹胀便溏、面色萎黄、肢体倦怠为核心表现。其病机为脾气不足、运化失健，导致水谷精微生化乏源，肌肉四肢失养。本证既可独立出现，亦常为脾阳虚、气血两虚等证的基础阶段。
description_en: Spleen Qi Vacuity is one of the most commonly encountered vacuity patterns in zang-fu differentiation, presenting with poor appetite, abdominal distension worse after eating, loose stools, sallow complexion, and limb fatigue. The pathomechanism centers on insufficient Spleen qi failing to transport and transform, so that the generation of qi and blood from food essence is impaired. This pattern frequently serves as the foundational stage from which Spleen yang vacuity or qi-blood dual vacuity may develop.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Insufficient Spleen qi with impaired movement and transformation.
etiology_en: Dietary irregularity, overexertion, Spleen damage from repletion worry and thinking, or lack of nourishment after prolonged illness.

cardinal_symptoms.zh: 脘腹重坠胀满，食后尤甚
cardinal_symptoms.en: heavy sagging sensation with fullness and distension of the epigastrium and abdomen, worse after eating
frequent urge to defecate with bearing-down sensation at the anus
persistent diarrhea, or in severe cases rectal prolapse

secondary_symptoms.en: shortness of breath and lack of strength

tongue.en: Pale tongue with white coating

pathomechanism_zh: 脾气虚弱，升举无力，清阳下陷

treatment_principle.en: Tonify the middle and augment qi; raise yang and lift sinking

description_zh: 脾气下陷证为脾气虚证的进一步发展，其核心病机为脾气虚弱、升举无力、清阳下陷。临床以脘腹重坠胀满、便意频数、肛门坠重为特征，严重者可见脱肛或子宫脱垂等内脏下垂。与脾气虚证的鉴别要点在于下陷症状的出现。治以补中益气、升阳举陷为法。
description_en: Spleen Qi Sinking is the progression of Spleen Qi Vacuity in which the Spleen's lifting function fails, so that clear yang sinks downward. The hallmark presentations are bearing-down sensations in the epigastrium and abdomen, frequent urge to defecate, and in severe cases organ prolapse (rectal or uterine). The key differentiating feature from simple Spleen qi vacuity is the presence of sinking and prolapse symptoms. Treatment centers on tonifying the middle, augmenting qi, and raising yang.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Spleen qi vacuity with failure to raise and lift, so the clear yang sinks downward.

cardinal_symptoms.zh: 妇女月经量少色淡，甚则经闭
cardinal_symptoms.en: scanty pale menstruation in women, or amenorrhea in severe cases

secondary_symptoms.en: numbness of the hands and feet

tongue.en: Pale tongue with white coating

pathomechanism_zh: 血液亏虚，脏腑形体失养

treatment_principle.en: Tonify and nourish blood

description_zh: 血虚证以面色淡白或萎黄、唇甲色淡、头晕心悸、失眠及妇女月经量少为主要表现。其病机为血液亏虚、脏腑形体失养，可因失血过多、脾胃虚弱化源不足或久病耗血所致。血虚常与气虚并见，形成气血两虚之证。舌淡脉细为血虚的典型舌脉特征。
description_en: Blood Vacuity presents with pallor or sallow complexion, pale lips and nails, dizziness, palpitations, insomnia, and scanty pale menstruation in women. The pathomechanism is insufficient blood failing to nourish the organs, sinews, and vessels. It commonly arises from excessive blood loss, weak Spleen-Stomach failing to generate blood, or chronic illness consuming blood. Blood vacuity frequently coexists with qi vacuity. The pale tongue and thin pulse are its hallmark diagnostic signs.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Vacuous blood fails to nourish the zang-fu, flesh, and body.

name_pinyin: Wài Gǎn Fēng Hán Biǎo Shí Zhèng

tongue.en: Thin white coating

pathomechanism_zh: 风寒之邪束表，腠理闭塞，肺气失宣

treatment_principle.en: Acrid-warm sweating to release the exterior; diffuse the Lung and calm wheezing

description_zh: 外感风寒表实证为六经辨证太阳病之经典证型（太阳伤寒），以恶寒发热、无汗、头身疼痛、气喘为核心表现，脉浮紧、苔薄白。其病机为风寒束表、腠理闭塞、肺气失宣。与表虚证（太阳中风）的鉴别要点在于有无汗出：本证无汗而脉紧，表虚证汗出而脉缓。
description_en: Wind-Cold Exterior Repletion corresponds to the Taiyang cold-damage (shang han) presentation: aversion to cold with fever, absence of sweating, headache and body pain, and wheezing, with a floating tight pulse and thin white tongue coating. The pathomechanism is wind-cold binding the exterior, closing the interstices, and inhibiting Lung diffusion. The critical differential from the exterior vacuity (zhong feng) pattern is the absence of sweating and the tight (rather than moderate) pulse quality.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Wind-cold binds the exterior, the interstices are closed, and Lung qi fails to diffuse.

name_pinyin: Wài Gǎn Fēng Hán Biǎo Xū Zhèng

tongue.en: Thin white coating

pathomechanism_zh: 卫强营弱，营卫不和

treatment_principle.en: Release the muscle layer and harmonize ying and wei

description_zh: 外感风寒表虚证为太阳中风之证型，以发热恶风、汗出、头痛、脉浮缓为特征。其病机为卫强营弱、营卫不和，卫气抗邪于表而营阴不能内守，故见汗出恶风。与表实证的鉴别在于汗出与脉缓。治以解肌发表、调和营卫为法，桂枝汤为代表方。
description_en: Wind-Cold Exterior Vacuity corresponds to the Taiyang wind-strike (zhong feng) presentation: fever with aversion to wind, spontaneous sweating, headache, and a floating moderate pulse. The pathomechanism is disharmony between ying and wei — the defensive (wei) qi struggles against the pathogen at the surface while the nutritive (ying) level fails to hold, producing sweating and wind-sensitivity. The key differential from the exterior repletion pattern is the presence of sweating and the moderate (rather than tight) pulse. Guizhi Tang (Cinnamon Twig Decoction) is its classical formula.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Strong defensive qi with weak constructive qi — constructive and defensive qi are disharmonized.

cardinal_symptoms.en: bitter fullness of the chest and hypochondrium
bitter taste in the mouth, dry throat, and dizziness

tongue.en: White coating

pathomechanism_zh: 邪犯少阳，枢机不利，胆火内郁

treatment_principle.en: Harmonize the Shaoyang

description_zh: 少阳证为伤寒六经辨证的半表半里证，以往来寒热、胸胁苦满、默默不欲饮食、心烦喜呕、口苦咽干目眩为核心表现。其病机为邪犯少阳、枢机不利、胆火内郁。既非纯表亦非纯里，不可汗、不可下，唯宜和解一法。
description_en: The Shaoyang Pattern is the half-exterior, half-interior stage of the six-channel system, characterized by alternating chills and fever, bitter fullness of the chest and hypochondrium, taciturnity and loss of appetite, vexation with tendency to vomit, and bitter taste with dry throat and dizziness. The pathomechanism involves the pathogen lodging in the Shaoyang pivot, obstructing the free flow of the pivot mechanism and causing Gallbladder fire constraint. Neither sweating nor purging is appropriate; harmonization is the only correct strategy.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Pathogen invades the Shaoyang, the pivot is obstructed, and Gallbladder fire is depressed internally.

cardinal_symptoms.en: wandering distending pain in the chest, hypochondrium, or lower abdomen

cardinal_symptoms.zh: 妇女月经不调，经前乳房胀痛
cardinal_symptoms.en: irregular menstruation and premenstrual breast distension and pain in women

tongue.en: Thin white coating

pathomechanism_zh: 肝失疏泄，气机郁滞

treatment_principle.en: Course the Liver and resolve depression; regulate qi and harmonize blood

description_zh: 肝气郁结证为脏腑辨证中最常见的实证之一，以情志抑郁、胸胁或少腹胀痛走窜、善太息、妇女经前乳房胀痛为核心表现。其病机为肝失疏泄、气机郁滞，多因情志不遂而起。肝郁日久可化火、可生痰、可犯脾胃，演变为多种复杂病证。脉弦为其特征性脉象。
description_en: Liver Qi Stagnation is one of the most prevalent repletion patterns in clinical practice, presenting with emotional depression, wandering distending pain in the chest, hypochondrium, or lower abdomen, frequent sighing, and premenstrual breast distension. The pathomechanism is the Liver's failure to maintain free coursing, leading to qi stagnation. If prolonged, it may transform into fire, generate phlegm, or invade the Spleen and Stomach, evolving into complex compound patterns. The wiry (xian) pulse is its characteristic pulse quality.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Liver fails to govern free-coursing, and qi dynamics are depressed and stagnant.

cardinal_symptoms.en: soreness, weakness, and cold pain of the lower back and knees
aversion to cold and cold limbs, especially the lower limbs
impotence and male infertility, or infertility due to cold uterus
clear copious urination with frequent nocturia

secondary_symptoms.en: bright pale or dark soot-black complexion

tongue.en: Pale, swollen tongue with a white, slippery coating

pulse.en: Deep, slow, and forceless pulse, especially at the chi position

pathomechanism_zh: 肾阳亏虚，温煦失职，气化无权

treatment_principle.en: Warm and tonify kidney yang

description_zh: 肾阳虚证以腰膝酸软冷痛、畏寒肢冷（下肢尤甚）、精神萎靡、阳痿或宫寒不孕、小便清长为核心表现。其病机为肾阳亏虚、温煦失职、气化无权。肾阳为一身阳气之根本，肾阳虚衰则脾阳、心阳亦可受累，出现五更泻、水肿等兼症。舌淡胖苔白滑、脉沉迟无力为典型舌脉。
description_en: Kidney Yang Vacuity presents with cold pain and weakness of the lower back and knees, aversion to cold with cold limbs (especially the lower body), listlessness, impotence or cold-uterus infertility, and clear copious urination. The pathomechanism is depletion of Kidney yang with failure of warming and qi transformation. Since Kidney yang is the root of all yang in the body, its decline can secondarily affect the Spleen (daybreak diarrhea) and Heart. The pale swollen tongue with white slippery coating and deep slow pulse are characteristic.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Kidney yang is vacuous and depleted, failing to warm and steam; qi transformation loses its authority.

cardinal_symptoms.en: cough with copious thin white phlegm
glomus and oppression in the chest and epigastrium

secondary_symptoms.en: poor appetite and reduced food intake

tongue.en: Swollen tongue with white, greasy coating

etiology_zh: 脾失健运，水湿内停，凝聚成痰
pathomechanism_zh: 脾虚湿盛，痰浊内生

treatment_principle.en: Dry dampness, transform phlegm, regulate qi

description_zh: 痰湿证以咳嗽痰多色白质稀、胸脘痞闷、恶心呕吐、头晕心悸、肢体困重为核心表现。其病机为脾失健运、水湿内停、凝聚成痰，痰浊阻滞气机。中医有「脾为生痰之源，肺为贮痰之器」之说，故痰湿证常涉及脾肺两脏。舌淡胖苔白腻、脉滑为其典型特征。
description_en: The Phlegm-Damp Pattern presents with copious thin white phlegm, chest and epigastric oppression, nausea and vomiting, dizziness, palpitations, and heaviness of the limbs. The pathomechanism involves the Spleen failing to transport and transform, so that accumulated dampness congeals into phlegm that obstructs the qi dynamic. As the classical saying goes, "the Spleen is the source of phlegm production, the Lung is the vessel that stores it," hence both organs are typically involved. The swollen tongue with white greasy coating and slippery pulse are hallmark signs.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Spleen vacuity with abundant dampness engenders phlegm turbidity internally.
etiology_en: Impaired Spleen movement allows water-dampness to accumulate internally and congeal into phlegm.

cardinal_symptoms.en: heat in the five centers (palms, soles, and chest)

tongue.en: Red tongue with scanty or no coating

etiology_zh: 热病伤阴，久病耗阴，房事不节，情志过极化火
pathomechanism_zh: 阴液亏少，无以制阳，虚热内生

treatment_principle.en: Enrich yin and clear heat

description_zh: 阴虚证为气血津液辨证中的基本证型，以形体消瘦、口燥咽干、五心烦热、潮热盗汗、颧红为核心表现。其病机为阴液亏少、无以制阳、虚热内生。可因热病伤阴、久病耗阴、房事不节或情志化火所致。舌红少苔、脉细数为阴虚的标志性舌脉。各脏阴虚证在此基础上各有特异表现。
description_en: Yin Vacuity is a foundational pattern in qi-blood-fluid differentiation, presenting with emaciation, dry mouth and throat, five-center heat, tidal fever, night sweating, and malar flush. The pathomechanism is depletion of yin fluids failing to restrain yang, generating empty heat. Causes include febrile disease consuming yin, chronic illness, sexual repletion, or emotional fire. The red tongue with scanty coating and thin rapid pulse are its signature diagnostic features. Each organ-specific yin vacuity pattern builds upon this core presentation with organ-particular signs.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Yin humor is diminished and cannot restrain yang, giving rise to internal vacuity heat.
etiology_en: Yin damaged by febrile disease, consumed by chronic illness, depleted by unregulated sexual activity, or burned away by extreme emotions transforming into fire.

cardinal_symptoms.en: distending pain of the head and eyes

secondary_symptoms.en: soreness and weakness of the lower back and knees

tongue.en: Red tongue with yellow coating

etiology_zh: 情志失调，肝郁化火；或肝肾阴虚，水不涵木，阳亢于上
pathomechanism_zh: 肝肾阴虚于下，肝阳亢逆于上

treatment_principle.en: Pacify the Liver, subdue yang, enrich yin and direct fire downward

description_zh: 肝阳上亢证以眩晕耳鸣、头目胀痛、面红目赤、急躁易怒为核心表现，常伴失眠多梦、腰膝酸软。其病机为肝肾阴虚于下、水不涵木、肝阳亢逆于上，呈上实下虚之象。本证介于虚实之间，治须平肝潜阳与滋阴并举。若阳亢化风，则可发展为肝风内动。
description_en: Liver Yang Rising presents with dizziness, tinnitus, distending pain of the head and eyes, red face, and easy anger, often accompanied by insomnia and lumbar-knee weakness. The pathomechanism is Liver-Kidney yin vacuity below failing to anchor yang, which flares upward — producing a pattern that is repletion above and deficient below. Treatment must simultaneously pacify and subdue the rising yang while enriching the yin root. If yang rising intensifies, it may stir internal Liver wind, a dangerous progression.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Liver and Kidney yin are vacuous below, while Liver yang is hyperactive and counterflowing above.
etiology_en: Emotional disharmony with Liver depression transforming into fire; or Liver and Kidney yin vacuity where water fails to moisten wood, so yang becomes hyperactive above.

cardinal_symptoms.en: abdominal fullness with hard pain that refuses pressure
in severe cases, clouded consciousness and delirious speech

secondary_symptoms.en: profuse sweating of the hands and feet

tongue.zh: 舌红苔黄燥或焦黑起刺
tongue.en: Red tongue with dry yellow or scorched black coating with prickles

etiology_zh: 外感邪气化热，与肠中糟粕相结，形成燥屎
pathomechanism_zh: 邪热与糟粕相搏，结于阳明之腑

treatment_principle.en: Drastically purge heat accumulation

description_zh: 阳明腑实证为六经辨证中的里实热证，以日晡潮热、腹满硬痛拒按、大便秘结、甚则神昏谵语为核心表现。其病机为外感邪气化热，与肠中糟粕相结形成燥屎，邪热与糟粕搏结于阳明之腑。舌红苔黄燥甚至焦黑、脉沉实有力为确诊依据。治以峻下热结为法，大承气汤为代表方。
description_en: Yangming Bowel Repletion is the interior repletion-heat pattern of the six-channel system, presenting with late-afternoon tidal fever, abdominal fullness with hard pain that refuses pressure, constipation, and in severe cases clouded consciousness with delirious speech. The pathomechanism involves heat from the exterior transmission binding with food residue in the bowel to form dry stool masses. The red tongue with dry yellow or scorched black coating and the deep forceful pulse are confirmatory. Treatment requires drastic purging of heat accumulation, for which Da Chengqi Tang is the representative formula.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Pathogenic heat contends with undigested waste, binding in the yangming bowel.
etiology_en: Externally contracted pathogen transforms into heat and binds with intestinal waste, forming dry stools.

name_en: Qi and Blood Dual Vacuity Pattern

cardinal_symptoms.en: shortness of breath and reluctance to speak

secondary_symptoms.en: reduced food intake and loose stools

tongue.en: Pale tongue with white coating

etiology_zh: 久病不愈，先伤气后伤血；或失血过多，气随血脱；或脾胃虚弱，气血生化无源
pathomechanism_zh: 气虚与血虚并存，气不生血，血不养气

treatment_principle.en: Tonify both qi and blood

description_zh: 气血两虚证为气虚与血虚并存的复合证型，以面色淡白或萎黄、头晕心悸、气短懒言、肢体倦怠为核心表现。其病机为气虚则血无以生、血虚则气无以附，两者互为因果。多见于久病不愈、失血过多或脾胃虚弱化源不足者。舌淡苔白、脉细弱为其典型舌脉。治宜气血双补。
description_en: Qi and Blood Dual Vacuity is a compound pattern in which qi vacuity and blood vacuity coexist and reinforce each other: insufficient qi cannot generate blood, and depleted blood cannot carry qi. It presents with pallor, dizziness, palpitations, insomnia, shortness of breath, and fatigue. Common causes include chronic illness, excessive blood loss, and Spleen-Stomach weakness failing to generate qi and blood. The pale tongue with white coating and thin weak pulse are characteristic. Treatment must supplement both qi and blood simultaneously.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Qi vacuity and blood vacuity coexist — qi fails to generate blood, and blood fails to nourish qi.
etiology_en: Prolonged illness damages qi and then blood; or excessive blood loss with qi collapsing after the blood; or Spleen-Stomach vacuity with no source to generate qi and blood.

cardinal_symptoms.en: sensation of something stuck in the throat like a plum pit
fullness and oppression in the chest and hypochondrium

tongue.en: Pale red tongue with moist white or white greasy coating

pulse.en: Wiry and moderate, or wiry and slippery pulse

etiology_zh: 情志不遂，肝气郁结，痰气互结于咽喉
pathomechanism_zh: 气郁痰凝，结于咽喉

treatment_principle.en: Move qi and dissipate nodulation; descend rebellion and transform phlegm

description_zh: 梅核气以咽中如有异物梗阻、咯之不出、咽之不下为特征性表现，伴胸胁满闷。其病机为情志不遂、肝气郁结、痰气互结于咽喉，非实质性占位，吞咽饮食并无障碍。本证多见于情志敏感之人，与现代医学之癔球症相对应。半夏厚朴汤为其经典治方。
description_en: Plum Pit Qi is characterized by the sensation of a foreign body lodged in the throat that can neither be coughed up nor swallowed down, with fullness and oppression in the chest and hypochondrium. The pathomechanism involves emotional frustration causing Liver qi stagnation, which combines with phlegm to form a qi-phlegm nodulation in the throat — there is no physical obstruction, and swallowing food is unimpaired. This pattern corresponds to globus hystericus in modern medicine. Banxia Houpo Tang is the classical formula.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Depressed qi with congealed phlegm bound in the throat.
etiology_en: Emotional frustration with Liver qi depression, so qi and phlegm bind together in the throat.

name_en: Damp Obstructing the Middle Burner Pattern

cardinal_symptoms.en: glomus, oppression, distension, and fullness of the epigastrium and abdomen
poor appetite and reduced food intake
bland tastelessness, or sweet sticky taste in the mouth

secondary_symptoms.en: heaviness of the head as if wrapped

tongue.en: Pale, swollen tongue with teeth marks and white greasy coating

etiology_zh: 饮食不节，过食生冷油腻；或外感湿邪，困遏脾胃
pathomechanism_zh: 湿邪困遏中焦，脾胃运化失常

treatment_principle.en: Dry dampness and transport in the Spleen; move qi and harmonize the Stomach

description_zh: 湿阻中焦证以脘腹痞闷胀满、纳呆食少、口淡或口甜口黏、肢体困重、大便溏薄为核心表现。其病机为湿邪困遏中焦、脾胃运化失常，可因饮食不节、过食生冷油腻或外感湿邪所致。舌淡胖有齿痕苔白腻、脉濡缓为湿困脾胃之典型舌脉。治以燥湿运脾、行气和胃为法。
description_en: Damp Obstructing the Middle Burner presents with epigastric and abdominal glomus, oppression, and distension, poor appetite, bland or sweet sticky taste in the mouth, heaviness of the limbs, and loose thin stools. The pathomechanism centers on dampness encumbering the middle burner and impeding the Spleen-Stomach's transport and transformation. The pale swollen tongue with tooth marks and white greasy coating, together with the soggy moderate pulse, are hallmark diagnostic features. Treatment focuses on drying dampness, moving the Spleen, and harmonizing the Stomach.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Dampness encumbers the middle jiao, and Spleen-Stomach movement and transformation lose their norm.
etiology_en: Dietary irregularity with excessive cold or greasy food, or externally contracted damp pathogen, obstructing the Spleen and Stomach.

cardinal_symptoms.en: shortness of breath, aggravated by exertion
mental fatigue and lack of strength

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Damp-heat accumulates in the Large Intestine, obstructing qi and blood; the bowel qi is blocked, the membranes and vessels are damaged, and conduction fails.
etiology_en: Unclean food, excessive consumption of rich, pungent, cold, or spoiled foods; or externally contracted summer-heat, damp, or toxic pathogens invading the bowel.

cardinal_symptoms.en: frequent urgent scanty dark painful urination

cardinal_symptoms.zh: 尿血或排尿困难，或尿有砂石
cardinal_symptoms.en: hematuria, difficulty urinating, or urinary gravel
distension and pain in the lower abdomen
fever, or distending pain in the lower back

secondary_symptoms.en: bitter sticky taste in the mouth
thirst without desire to drink much

tongue.en: Red tongue with a yellow, greasy coating

etiology_zh: 外感湿热之邪，蕴结下焦；或饮食不节，嗜食肥甘辛辣，湿热内生，下注膀胱
pathomechanism_zh: 湿热蕴结膀胱，气化不利，水道不畅，热伤血络

treatment_principle.en: Clear heat, disinhibit dampness, and free strangury

description_zh: 膀胱湿热证以小便频急短赤灼痛、淋沥不畅、尿血或排尿困难、少腹胀痛为核心表现。其病机为湿热蕴结膀胱、气化不利、水道不畅、热伤血络。多因外感湿热或饮食不节、湿热内生下注膀胱所致。舌红苔黄腻、脉滑数为典型舌脉。本证对应现代医学之泌尿系感染及结石。
description_en: Bladder Damp-Heat presents with frequent urgent scanty dark painful urination, dribbling inhibited flow, hematuria or difficulty urinating, and lower abdominal distension and pain. The pathomechanism involves damp-heat accumulating in the Bladder, impairing qi transformation, obstructing the water passages, and scorching the blood network. The red tongue with yellow greasy coating and slippery rapid pulse are diagnostic. This pattern corresponds to urinary tract infections and urolithiasis in modern medicine.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Damp-heat binds in the Bladder; qi transformation is inhibited, the waterways are obstructed, and heat damages the blood vessels.
etiology_en: Externally contracted damp-heat binding in the lower jiao; or dietary irregularity with a preference for rich and pungent foods engendering internal damp-heat that pours down into the Bladder.

secondary_symptoms.en: mental fatigue and lack of strength

tongue.en: Pale tongue with white coating

pulse.en: Deep and moderate or slow pulse

etiology_zh: 外邪直中太阴，或三阳病误治损伤脾阳，寒湿内盛
pathomechanism_zh: 脾阳虚衰，运化失司，寒湿内停，升降失常

treatment_principle.en: Warm the middle and dispel cold, strengthen spleen and dry dampness

description_zh: 太阴病证为六经辨证中三阴病的第一阶段，以腹满而吐、食不下、自利不渴、时腹自痛为核心表现。其病机为脾阳虚衰、运化失司、寒湿内停、升降失常。多因外邪直中太阴或三阳病误治损伤脾阳所致。「自利不渴」为太阴病与阳明病的鉴别要点。治以温中散寒、健脾燥湿为法。
description_en: The Taiyin Stage Pattern is the first of the three yin stages in six-channel differentiation, presenting with abdominal fullness and vomiting, inability to eat, spontaneous diarrhea without thirst, and intermittent abdominal pain. The pathomechanism is Spleen yang debility with cold-damp accumulation and disordered ascending-descending. "Diarrhea without thirst" is the key feature distinguishing it from yangming patterns. Treatment warms the middle, dispels cold, and dries dampness.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Spleen yang is debilitated, movement and transformation fail, cold-dampness accumulates internally, and upbearing and downbearing lose their norm.
etiology_en: External pathogen striking Taiyin directly, or three-yang disease mistreated so that Spleen yang is damaged and cold-dampness becomes exuberant internally.

cardinal_symptoms.en: aversion to cold with curled-up lying
reversal cold of the four limbs

tongue.en: Pale tongue with white slippery coating

etiology_zh: 心肾阳虚，或误汗误下损伤少阴阳气，阴寒内盛
pathomechanism_zh: 心肾阳衰，阴寒内盛，阳气不能温煦四末，气化失司

treatment_principle.en: Restore yang and rescue from counterflow

description_zh: 少阴寒化证为六经辨证中的危重证型，以但欲寐、恶寒踡卧、四肢厥逆、下利清谷为核心表现。其病机为心肾阳衰、阴寒内盛，阳气不能温煦四末。「但欲寐」和「脉微细」为少阴病的提纲特征。本证病势危急，若不及时回阳救逆，可致阳亡之变。四逆汤为其代表方。
description_en: The Shaoyin Cold Transformation Pattern is a critical condition in six-channel differentiation, presenting with constant desire to sleep, aversion to cold with curled-up lying, reversal cold of the limbs, and diarrhea with undigested food. The pathomechanism is Heart and Kidney yang collapse with yin-cold predominating internally. "Constant desire to sleep" and the "faint thin pulse" are the defining features of Shaoyin disease. This is an emergency pattern requiring urgent restoration of yang; failure to treat may lead to yang desertion. Sini Tang is the representative formula.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Heart and Kidney yang are debilitated, yin-cold is exuberant internally, yang qi fails to warm the four extremities, and qi transformation fails.
etiology_en: Heart and Kidney yang vacuity, or mistaken sweating or purging damaging Shaoyin yang qi, with yin-cold exuberant internally.

cardinal_symptoms.en: qi surging up to the heart with hot pain in the chest
hunger without desire to eat; eating provokes vomiting of roundworms
alternating reversal cold of the limbs and fever

tongue.en: Red tongue with white or yellow coating

etiology_zh: 病至厥阴，肝失疏泄，阴阳气不相顺接，寒热错杂
pathomechanism_zh: 厥阴肝经寒热错杂，阴阳胜复，上热下寒

treatment_principle.en: Harmonize cold and heat, reconcile Jueyin

description_zh: 厥阴病证为六经辨证的终末阶段，以消渴、气上撞心、心中疼热、饥不欲食（食则吐蛔）、手足厥冷与发热往来为核心表现。其病机为厥阴肝经寒热错杂、阴阳胜复、上热下寒。本证病理最为复杂，寒热并见为其最大特点。治须寒热并调、和解厥阴。乌梅丸为其代表方。
description_en: The Jueyin Stage Pattern is the terminal stage of the six-channel system, presenting with wasting-thirst, qi surging up to the heart with hot chest pain, hunger without desire to eat (eating provokes roundworm vomiting), and alternating reversal cold of the limbs and fever. The pathomechanism involves cold-heat complexity in the Jueyin, with yin and yang in mutual struggle, producing heat above and cold below. The coexistence of cold and heat signs is its defining characteristic. Treatment must address both cold and heat simultaneously. Wumei Wan is the representative formula.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Cold and heat are intermixed in the Jueyin (Liver) channel; yin and yang alternately prevail, with heat above and cold below.
etiology_en: Disease reaches the Jueyin stage; the Liver fails to govern free-coursing, yin and yang qi fail to meet in smooth transition, and cold and heat become intermixed.

cardinal_symptoms.en: great thirst with desire to drink

tongue.en: Red tongue with dry yellow coating

etiology_zh: 太阳病失治，邪热入里化燥，传入阳明经，充斥内外
pathomechanism_zh: 邪热内传阳明，里热炽盛，弥漫全身，热盛伤津

treatment_principle.en: Acrid-cold to clear qi-level heat, generate fluids and stop thirst

description_zh: 阳明经证以身大热、大汗出、大渴引饮、脉洪大为核心表现（四大症），是六经辨证中典型的里热炽盛证。其病机为太阳病邪热入里、传入阳明经，弥漫全身。与阳明腑实证的鉴别在于本证无腹满便秘等腑实之征。治以辛寒清气、生津止渴为法，白虎汤为代表方。
description_en: The Yangming Channel Pattern presents with the "four greats": great body heat, great sweating, great thirst with desire to drink, and a surging large pulse. It represents blazing interior heat diffusing throughout the body after transmission from the Taiyang stage. The key differential from Yangming Bowel Repletion is the absence of bowel signs (abdominal fullness, constipation, hard pain). Treatment uses acrid-cold methods to clear qi-level heat and generate fluids; Baihu Tang (White Tiger Decoction) is the representative formula.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Pathogenic heat is transmitted internally to the yangming channel; interior heat is effulgent, spreads throughout the body, and damages the fluids.
etiology_en: Taiyang disease left untreated allows pathogenic heat to enter the interior and dry out, then transmit into the yangming channel, filling interior and exterior.

cardinal_symptoms.en: fever with slight aversion to wind and cold

secondary_symptoms.en: redness or pain of the throat
absence of sweating or scant sweating

tongue.en: Red tongue tip and edges with thin white coating

etiology_zh: 温热邪气从口鼻或皮毛而入，侵袭肺卫
pathomechanism_zh: 温邪袭表，肺卫失宣，卫气被郁

treatment_principle.en: Acrid-cool release of the exterior, diffuse the lung and vent the pathogen

description_zh: 卫分证为卫气营血辨证的初始阶段，以发热微恶风寒、头痛、咳嗽、口微渴为核心表现。其病机为温热邪气侵袭肺卫、卫气被郁。舌边尖红苔薄白、脉浮数为其典型舌脉。与伤寒表证的鉴别在于卫分证发热重恶寒轻，口渴咽红，属温热病范畴。治以辛凉解表、宣肺透邪为法。
description_en: The Wei-level (Defense) Pattern is the initial stage of warm-disease (wen bing) four-level differentiation, presenting with fever, slight aversion to wind and cold, headache, cough, and mild thirst. The pathomechanism involves warm-heat evil invading the Lung and defense level, constraining the defensive qi. The red tongue tip and edges with thin white coating and floating rapid pulse are characteristic. It is differentiated from cold-damage exterior patterns by the predominance of fever over cold aversion and the presence of thirst and throat redness.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Warm pathogen invades the exterior; Lung and defensive qi fail to diffuse, and defensive qi is depressed.
etiology_en: Warm pathogenic qi enters via the mouth, nose, skin, or body hair, invading the Lung and defensive qi.

cardinal_symptoms.en: vigorous fever without aversion to cold but with aversion to heat

tongue.en: Red tongue with yellow coating

pulse.en: Surging large or slippery rapid pulse

etiology_zh: 温邪不解，由卫入气，或直入气分，里热炽盛
pathomechanism_zh: 邪热内传气分，里热炽盛，热迫津泄，气机壅滞

treatment_principle.en: Clear heat and drain fire, generate fluids and stop thirst

description_zh: 气分证为卫气营血辨证的第二阶段，以壮热不恶寒反恶热、汗多口渴、面赤心烦、小便短赤为核心表现。其病机为邪热内传气分、里热炽盛、热迫津泄。较卫分证热势更甚、不再有恶寒。舌红苔黄、脉洪大或滑数为典型舌脉。治以清热泻火、生津止渴为法。
description_en: The Qi-level Pattern is the second stage of four-level differentiation, presenting with vigorous fever without aversion to cold but aversion to heat, profuse sweating, thirst, red face, vexation, and short dark urination. The pathomechanism involves the pathogen penetrating to the qi level, generating intense interior heat that forces fluids outward. Compared to the wei level, the heat is much stronger and aversion to cold has been replaced by aversion to heat. The red tongue with yellow coating and surging or slippery rapid pulse are characteristic.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Pathogenic heat is transmitted into the qi level; interior heat is effulgent, forcing fluids outward, and qi dynamics are obstructed.
etiology_en: Warm pathogen is not resolved and advances from the defensive level to the qi level, or enters the qi level directly, with exuberant interior heat.

tongue.en: Crimson tongue with scanty coating

etiology_zh: 温热邪气由气分内传营分，或邪气直入营分，热灼营阴
pathomechanism_zh: 热入营分，营阴受灼，心神被扰，血络外涌

treatment_principle.en: Clear ying-level and drain heat, vent heat outward to qi-level

description_zh: 营分证为卫气营血辨证的第三阶段，以身热夜甚、心烦不寐、时有谵语、斑疹隐隐为核心表现。其病机为热入营分、营阴受灼、心神被扰。特征为「口反不甚渴」（热已入营，不在气分），舌红绛少苔、脉细数。热入营分表示病情已深入，须清营泄热、透热转气。
description_en: The Ying-level (Nutritive) Pattern is the third stage of four-level differentiation, presenting with body heat worse at night, vexation and insomnia, intermittent delirious speech, and faint macules and papules. The pathomechanism involves heat entering the nutritive level, scorching ying-yin and disturbing the spirit-mind. Paradoxically thirst is not pronounced (the heat is deeper than the qi level). The crimson tongue with scanty coating and thin rapid pulse are diagnostic. Treatment must clear the ying level and vent heat outward back to the qi level.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Heat enters the constructive level; the constructive yin is scorched, the Heart spirit is harassed, and blood vessels overflow outward.
etiology_en: Warm pathogenic qi is transmitted internally from the qi level into the constructive level, or enters the constructive level directly, with heat scorching the constructive yin.

tongue.en: Deep crimson tongue with scanty or no coating

etiology_zh: 温热邪气深入血分，热毒炽盛，灼伤血络
pathomechanism_zh: 热盛动血，迫血妄行，耗血伤阴，甚则内陷心包

treatment_principle.en: Cool the blood and disperse blood stasis, clear heat and resolve toxin

description_zh: 血分证为卫气营血辨证的最深阶段，以身灼热、躁扰昏狂、斑疹紫黑、吐血衄血便血为核心表现。其病机为热毒深入血分、热盛动血、迫血妄行、耗血伤阴。舌深绛少苔或无苔为极度热盛伤阴之征。本阶段病情最为危重，可伴抽搐（热极生风），须凉血散血、清热解毒。
description_en: The Xue-level (Blood) Pattern is the deepest and most critical stage of four-level differentiation, presenting with scorching body heat, manic agitation and delirium, dark purple macules, hematemesis, epistaxis, and bloody stools. The pathomechanism involves heat toxin penetrating the blood level, stirring blood into reckless movement and consuming blood and yin. The deep crimson tongue with scanty or absent coating reflects extreme heat damaging yin. Convulsions may occur (extreme heat generating wind). Treatment requires cooling the blood, dispersing stasis, and resolving toxin.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Excessive heat stirs the blood, forcing it to move recklessly; blood is consumed and yin is damaged, with possible internal collapse into the Pericardium.
etiology_en: Warm pathogenic qi penetrates deeply into the blood level, with exuberant heat toxin scorching the blood vessels.

cardinal_symptoms.en: heaviness of the head and body with fatigue

secondary_symptoms.en: no thirst or thirst without desire to drink

tongue.en: White greasy coating

etiology_zh: 湿热之邪从口鼻或皮毛而入，侵袭上焦肺卫
pathomechanism_zh: 湿热郁遏上焦，肺气失宣，卫阳被困，湿遏热伏

treatment_principle.en: Diffuse and free qi movement, clear and drain damp-heat

description_zh: 上焦湿热证为三焦辨证中湿热病初起的证型，以头重身困、午后发热、胸闷脘痞、咳嗽为核心表现。其病机为湿热郁遏上焦、肺气失宣、卫阳被困。特征为热势不高、午后尤甚，口不渴或渴不欲饮，反映湿重于热。苔白腻、脉濡数为典型舌脉。治以宣畅气机、清利湿热为法。
description_en: Upper Burner Damp-Heat is the initial stage of three-burner damp-heat disease, presenting with heaviness of the head and body, afternoon fever, chest oppression and epigastric glomus, and cough. The pathomechanism involves damp-heat obstructing the upper burner, inhibiting Lung diffusion and trapping defensive yang. The fever is low-grade and worse in the afternoon, with no or little thirst, reflecting dampness predominating over heat. The white greasy coating and soggy rapid pulse are characteristic. Treatment focuses on diffusing qi movement and clearing damp-heat.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Damp-heat obstructs the upper jiao; Lung qi fails to diffuse, defensive yang is trapped, and dampness obscures latent heat.
etiology_en: Damp-heat pathogen enters via the mouth, nose, or body hair and invades the upper jiao Lung and defensive qi.

cardinal_symptoms.en: epigastric and abdominal fullness and distension
loose thin stools or sticky incomplete stools

tongue.en: Red tongue with yellow greasy coating

etiology_zh: 湿热内蕴中焦，或外感湿热，或饮食不节，脾胃运化失司
pathomechanism_zh: 湿热蕴结脾胃，升降失常，气机壅滞，湿热交蒸

treatment_principle.en: Acrid-opening and bitter-draining, clear heat and transform dampness

description_zh: 中焦湿热证为三焦辨证的中期阶段，以身热不扬、脘腹胀满、恶心呕吐、大便溏薄或黏滞不爽为核心表现。其病机为湿热蕴结脾胃、升降失常、气机壅滞。「身热不扬」为湿遏热伏的特征性体征——体温虽高，但初按肌肤不觉灼热。苔黄腻、脉濡数为典型舌脉。治以辛开苦降、清热化湿为法。
description_en: Middle Burner Damp-Heat is the middle stage of three-burner differentiation, presenting with unsurfaced body heat, epigastric and abdominal fullness and distension, nausea and vomiting, and loose or sticky incomplete stools. The pathomechanism involves damp-heat binding in the Spleen and Stomach, disrupting ascending and descending, and obstructing the qi dynamic. The characteristic "unsurfaced heat" means the temperature is elevated but the skin does not initially feel hot to touch — dampness concealing the heat. The yellow greasy coating and soggy rapid pulse are diagnostic.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Damp-heat binds the Spleen and Stomach; upbearing and downbearing lose their norm, qi dynamics are obstructed, and damp-heat steams together.
etiology_en: Damp-heat accumulates in the middle jiao — whether from external contraction, dietary irregularity, or impaired Spleen-Stomach movement and transformation.

cardinal_symptoms.zh: 大便赤白黏液或肛门灼热
cardinal_symptoms.en: red and white mucoid stools or burning sensation at the anus
distension and pain in the lower abdomen

tongue.en: Red tongue with yellow greasy coating

pulse.en: Slippery rapid or soggy rapid pulse

etiology_zh: 湿热之邪下注下焦，或中焦湿热下流，蕴结膀胱大肠
pathomechanism_zh: 湿热下注膀胱大肠，气化失司，传导失常，脉络受灼

treatment_principle.en: Clear heat and drain dampness

description_zh: 下焦湿热证为三焦辨证的后期阶段，以小便短赤涩痛、大便赤白黏液或肛门灼热、少腹胀痛、下肢浮肿为核心表现。其病机为湿热下注膀胱大肠、气化失司、传导失常、脉络受灼。可因湿热之邪下流下焦或中焦湿热下注所致。舌红苔黄腻、脉滑数或濡数为典型舌脉。治以清热利湿为法。
description_en: Lower Burner Damp-Heat is the late stage of three-burner differentiation, presenting with scanty dark painful urination, red and white mucoid stools or anal burning, lower abdominal distension and pain, and edema of the lower limbs. The pathomechanism involves damp-heat pouring downward into the Bladder and Large Intestine, impairing qi transformation and bowel transmission, and scorching the local blood network. The red tongue with yellow greasy coating and slippery or soggy rapid pulse are characteristic. Treatment focuses on clearing heat and draining dampness from the lower burner.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

pathomechanism_en: Damp-heat pours down into the Bladder and Large Intestine; qi transformation fails, conduction is abnormal, and the vessels are scorched.
etiology_en: Damp-heat pathogen pours down into the lower jiao, or damp-heat from the middle jiao descends and binds in the Bladder and Large Intestine.

cardinal_symptoms.en: nasal congestion with clear runny discharge

tongue.en: Pale tongue with thin white coating

etiology_zh: 风寒之邪外袭，肺卫失宣
etiology_en: External invasion of wind-cold, impairing the Lung's diffusing and descending functions.
pathomechanism_zh: 风寒束肺，肺气失宣，津液不布
pathomechanism_en: Wind-cold binds the Lung, Lung qi fails to diffuse, and fluids are not distributed.

treatment_principle.en: Disperse wind-cold, diffuse the Lung and stop coughing

description_zh: 风寒犯肺证以咳嗽声重、痰白清稀、鼻塞流涕、恶寒发热为核心表现。其病机为风寒束肺、肺气失宣、津液不布。与外感风寒表实证的鉴别在于本证以咳嗽为主症。治以疏风散寒、宣肺止咳为法，代表方为杏苏散、止嗽散等。
description_en: Wind-Cold Invading the Lung presents with cough with a heavy sound, thin white sputum, nasal congestion with clear discharge, and aversion to cold with fever. The pathomechanism centers on wind-cold binding the Lung so that Lung qi fails to diffuse and descend, and fluids are not properly distributed. Unlike the simple exterior repletion pattern, here the cough is the chief complaint. Treatment focuses on dispersing wind-cold and diffusing the Lung.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

tongue.en: Red tongue with yellow greasy coating

etiology_zh: 外邪入里化热，炼液成痰，或内热壅盛，痰热互结
etiology_en: External pathogen transforming into heat internally, refining fluids into phlegm; or internal heat congestion with mutual binding of phlegm and heat.
